intent: Turn Glassbox 01 (One in a Thousand) into a scrollable, tinkerable narrative: read + decision beats, pinned paper stages, the existing model, and no fail state. Keep it performant and elegant using current web-platform primitives rather than a scroll library.
scope: src/games/glassbox/stages.tsx — ledger, sample, machine, defense sheets
src/index.css — paper/scrolly styles and responsive height compaction
scripts/glassbox-smoke.mjs — scroll, geometry, reduced-motion, and responsive checks
constraints: README + AGENTS guardrails: depict deception, never enable it; aggregate economics only; fictional figures; no real channels, scripts, targets, or tools.
No new dependency for scroll behavior; no new external assets.
Scroll is emphasis, never disclosure: every step remains in the DOM and in reading order.
Keyboard, screen-reader, and reduced-motion safe; no color-only meaning.
Model arithmetic and copy unchanged from the reviewed static cut.
Do not commit, push, or deploy without authorization.
acceptance_checks: Four scenes (#ledger, #sample, #machine, #defense) each pin a paper stage and activate every step by natural scroll, jump, and scrollbar drag.
Pinned stage fits at 390px, 320x568, and 1440x900; no horizontal overflow; compact/hide rules below 800px and 720px height; sticky released below 520px height.
Model outputs unchanged: default profit ₱450,000; human preset ₱500; break-even 98.3%; 100% verification −₱7,875 by slider and by Test animation.
Dot sample renders 1,000 spans, resolves marked dots at the payment beat, and is decorative; counts remain text.
Top rail and reveals use native CSS scroll/view timelines behind @supports; no scroll library; no per-frame JS beyond one rAF.
Reduced motion: no rail/reveals/dimming, all content visible, lever result immediate.
npm test, npm run build, glassbox smoke, hub smoke, axe — all green with zero console/page errors.
next_action: User review of the scrollytelling cut on phone and desktop. No commit, push, or deploy has been made. If approved, choose the next Glassbox piece (artifact economics, the Five Weeks reward loop, or the liar's dividend).

review.mode: self-review by the author; independent ./meos review unavailable (codex CLI not installed)
